initialExam.title: TNTET 2026 (Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test)
initialExam.description: Tamil Nadu TET for eligibility certification of teachers for primary and upper primary levels in TN government schools.
initialExam.qualifications: Teaching qualification as per NCTE norms
initialExam.syllabus: Paper I: Child Development, Tamil, English, Maths, EVS. Paper II: Child Development, Tamil, English, Subject.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I: 150 marks, 3 hours. Paper II: 150 marks, 3 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: TNTET Qualification → TN TRB Teacher Recruitment
initialExam.jobRole: Primary and Upper Primary Teacher in TN government schools
initialExam.careerGrowth: BT Assistant → Head Master → BEO → DEO.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit trb.tn.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
